notes.title: kuso Update #5
notes.notes:
kuso v3.0.0a Release Notes
- [b]The Options Menu[/b] has been streamlined to allow for more fine-tuning of sound options, as well as a better screen size option for folks who have very high resolution screens.

- [b]In-Game Achievements[/b]! I've added a new menu option on the title screen to keep track of your achievements in game! Also there's a new in-game toast when you get new achievements.

- [b]Local Leaderboards[/b]! Now your best time is saved locally and displayed when selecting a level in the...

- [b]New Level Select Menu[/b]! Now you can choose practice mode, speedrun mode, and YOLO mode! Practice mode lets you play any level you'd like from the entire game with the option for Slow Mo, and allows you to practice for your ideal speedrun time. YOLO mode will restart the level for you whenever you die, and can be combined with Speedrun mode to 

- [b]YOLO Medals[/b]! Want a new challenge? Go complete levels in YOLO Mode in Level Select to unlock YOLO medals. Collect them all and you will gain access to something special, aside from the 26th achievement!

- Bonus Level! Attain the YOLO achievement and you'll unlock one additional bonus level featuring new mechanics and a unique style. [i]Music for the Bonus Level is SC-1903, licensed from the Nash Music Library.[/i] Congrats to KC for being the first player to complete it!

- [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263870/]Hat[/url][/b][/i]! You've been begging for it, and now it's available. For only [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263870/]$4.99 USD[/url], you can equip fiveEight with their signature blue [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263870/]hat[/url]! You know, from the title screen of LOVE! The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263870/]hat[/url] provides absolutely no benefit whatsoever, but the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263870/]hat[/url] does fall off when you die, and has its own physics, so you can create your mountain of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263870/]hat[/url]s. 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263870/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27462936/83d12a8bf0d5e06180898206a609902890a90c7e.gif[/img][/url]

- kuso Level 6 is now 100% less random! I've listened to the Speedrun Community and with the help of [b]-7[/b] we've now got a much better object spawning pattern for Level 6 which will make speedrunning more fair.

- [url=https://discord.gg/jHhX6Np][b]The Discord[/b][/url]! Wait, okay, that's not an update, we've just still got a [url=https://discord.gg/jHhX6Np]Discord community[/url]! Come hang out and make friends and share your times and thoughts and dreams and wishes.

- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188000/Pulstario/]Pulstario[/url]! Not an update to kuso, but I've released another game on Steam called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188000/Pulstario/]Pulstario[/url]! It may have flown under the radar for you, but if you're looking for some more challenge and speedrun-goodness and good music from James Bennett and Oliver Whitehouse. Also it's only [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188000/Pulstario/]$0.99 USD[/url]!

notes.title: kuso Update #4 - The Final Secret
notes.notes:
I've been hinting for months that there's one final secret in kuso. It's my 32nd birthday and with the game on a brief deep sale, I figured I'd share with you what the final secret is.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27462936/228faca5c83e7360450fc13758ae6c76a6b9f51d.jpg[/img]

The final secret track will be added to the kuso Official Soundtrack Volume 2 in the coming weeks, so look forward to that.

If you picked up kuso as part of the current deep sale, please consider leaving the game a review. One of the best ways for games to get discovered on Steam is by user reviews. Your review matters, especially for small games like mine.

And in case you felt like double dipping, the game is now also available on the Nintendo Switch in North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand! Read more about that at www.kuso.ge !

Thank you so much for all your support.

notes.title: kuso Update #3
notes.notes:
This is a fairly small update for kuso fixing a few bugs I had missed with the huge update last week. If you find any issues, there's a couple of things you can do to help:

• We've got a stickied thread in the Steam Forums for official bug reports: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/578930/discussions/0/1479857071253239790/]LINK[/url]
• More directly, we've got an [i]Official Discord Server[/i] for kuso and LOVE, and I'm almost always available there: [url=https://discord.gg/jHhX6Np]DISCORD[/url]

[b]Soundtrack Update[/b]
There was a hiccup with Volume 2 of the kuso Soundtrack, but that's been fixed. Feel free to pick it up here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/979280/kuso__Soundtrack_Vol_2/

[b]A Simple Request[/b]
If you've enjoyed kuso and this update, please take a moment to leave a review on Steam. Steam Reviews are HUGELY helpful when it comes to helping new players find the game. So please, if you've got a minute, leave a review.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
• The audio files for Jellyfish and Nebula have been updated. James claims there was some sort of clicking that only he could hear. They've been replaced to satisfy James' needs.
• Added Leaderboards for LOVE any% and 100% as well as LOVE+kuso any% and 100%.
• Fixed Layering Problems on a number of levels
• Fixed Achievement not Popping for Complete Completionish
• Fixed Naming Issues on Leaderboards
• Fixed Level 22 not loading from Level Select

[b]In case you missed the last update, here's what was added to kuso[/b]
• 16 Levels - Completely remade levels from 2014's LOVE
• 16 Music Tracks including new tracks and remastered versions
• 2 Player Race Mode
• 9 Additional Levels
• 13 new Achievements
• Individual Level Speedrun Leaderboards for every level
• Additional Leaderboards for different gameplay modes
• Redone Menus
• Save & Quit in the middle of a non-speedrun mode
• In-Game Keyboard Remapping (Shift+F6 at any time)
• Audio Level Sliders
• Jukebox Mode with 49 selectable tracks
• New Secrets
• kuso is now available on the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/kuso-switch]Nintendo Switch[/url]


[i]Note to self: Never go on a week-long road trip the same day you launch a major update for a game and release a game on Nintendo Switch.[/i]

notes.title: kuso gets a huge update -- and a Nintendo Switch port!
notes.notes:
I'm gonna write a lot of things here, but you could instead hear and watch them right here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2RGab6STHAs&feature=youtu.be

As mentioned in the previous announcement, kuso is one year old. For the last year, I've been quietly working on updating the game behind the scenes for a big free update, so here's the patchnotes!

• 16 Levels - Completely remade levels from 2014's LOVE
• 16 Music Tracks including new tracks and remastered versions
• 2 Player Race Mode
• 9 Additional Levels
• 13 new Achievements
• Individual Level Speedrun Leaderboards for every level
• Additional Leaderboards for different gameplay modes
• Redone Menus
• Save & Quit in the middle of a non-speedrun mode
• In-Game Keyboard Remapping (Shift+F6 at any time)
• Audio Level Sliders
• Jukebox Mode with 49 selectable tracks
• New Secrets
• kuso is now available on the [url=https://t.co/GrVh9zlU87]Nintendo Switch[/url]!

We've added the kuso Original Soundtrack Volume 2, which includes all the music from the update as well as demo tracks and unused tracks made during the update's development. It's the only way we've monetized this update, so if you'd like to support us, that's a great way to do it.

I hope you enjoy this update, and I look forward to competing with y'all on individual runs!
